prompt: Support is drowning in validation errors nobody can map back to a form. Depending on which screen saved the record, the same bad input comes back as a flat list of sentences, an exception that blows up the whole request, or objects whose codes don't exist in the registry we publish - and the field paths and message wording drift enough that the frontend gives up and shows a generic toast. The convention we all agreed to is written down in docs/; make every module follow it. The tests under test/ are the reproductions we managed to write, not the whole acceptance criteria.
